introNew: Describe your model and what it is for. The risk tier follows from the intended use you declare; you do not choose it. The card is saved as a draft that only you and the reviewers can see until it is published.
introEdit: This card is a draft, so you can still change it. Once you submit it for review it can no longer be edited.

notEditable.title: This card can no longer be edited
notEditable.body: Only a draft can be edited, and only by the person who declared it. A submitted card can be returned to draft from its page.

intendedUse.label: Intended use
intendedUse.subtitle: Clinical task, population, users, care settings and misuse

evidence.label: Evidence and limits
evidence.subtitle: Training data, regulatory status, known limits

review.label: Review and save
review.subtitle: Check the card, then save it as a draft

slug.label: Model identifier
slug.hint: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, for example chest-xr-triage. It becomes the card’s address and cannot be changed later.
slug.hintEdit: The card’s address. It cannot be changed.

modelDeveloper.label: Developer
modelDeveloper.hint: The organisation accountable for the model, which may not be you.

developerContact.label: Developer contact
developerContact.hint: An e-mail address or web page for questions about the model. It is published with the card.

clinicalSummary.label: Clinical summary
clinicalSummary.hint: Two or three sentences for clinicians: what the model does and for whom.

architectureSummary.label: How the model works
architectureSummary.hint: A technical summary: architecture, inputs and outputs.

generativeAi.label: The model generates text, images or other content (generative AI)

medicalPurpose.label: Clinical task
medicalPurpose.hint: The clinical job the model does. It is the main input to the risk tier.

bodySystemOrSite.label: Body system or site
bodySystemOrSite.hint: For example chest, retina or breast.

targetPopulation.hint: The patients the model is meant for. Leave blank what does not apply.

populationDescription.label: Population description
populationDescription.hint: For example: adults referred for a chest radiograph in an outpatient clinic.

intendedUserRole.label: Intended users
intendedUserRole.hint: Who reads the model’s output. Choose all that apply.

operatingEnvironment.label: Care settings
operatingEnvironment.hint: Where the model is used. An emergency setting raises the tier of a triage or screening tool.

intendedClinicalPathway.label: Clinical pathway
intendedClinicalPathway.hint: Whether a clinician confirms the output before anyone acts on it. A model that acts alone gets a higher tier.

operatingPrinciple.label: Operating principle
operatingPrinciple.hint: In a sentence, for example: a convolutional network over the chest radiograph.

foreseeableMisuse.label: Foreseeable misuse
foreseeableMisuse.hint: How the model could be used wrongly, for example on a population it was not validated on.

contraindications.label: Contraindications
contraindications.hint: When the model must not be used. Leave blank if there are none known.

trainingDataSummary.label: Training data
trainingDataSummary.hint: Where the training data came from and how it was labelled. Seen by reviewers; not shown on the public page.

trainingDataJurisdictions.label: Training data jurisdictions
trainingDataJurisdictions.hint: Country or region codes, separated by commas, for example EU, CH.

knownBiases.label: Known limits and biases
knownBiases.hint: Groups or situations where the model is known to perform worse.

ongoingMaintenance.label: Monitoring after deployment
ongoingMaintenance.hint: How performance is followed once the model is in use.

tier.liveLabel: Risk tier from your answers so far
tier.pending: Choose a clinical task to see the risk tier.
tier.derivedFrom: The tier is derived from three of your answers, following the IMDRF matrix of how significant the information is and how serious the healthcare situation is. You cannot set it directly: to change it, change these answers.

meaning.II: Drives clinical action in a non-critical situation
meaning.III: Drives clinical action in a serious or critical situation
meaning.IV: Decides alone in a serious or critical situation

reason.informational-purpose: research, administrative and patient-education tools only inform; they do not drive care.
reason.critical-standalone: a diagnosis or treatment plan acted on without a clinician’s confirmation.
reason.critical-with-clinician: a diagnosis or treatment plan in a serious context, confirmed by a clinician.
reason.triage-screening-emergency: triage or screening used in an emergency setting.
reason.triage-screening: triage or screening outside an emergency setting, before a clinician sees the patient.
reason.prognosis-monitoring-standalone: prognosis or monitoring acted on without a clinician’s confirmation.
reason.prognosis-monitoring: prognosis or monitoring with a clinician in the loop.
reason.decision-support: clinical decision support: a clinician makes the decision.
reason.other-purpose: a task outside the list gets the cautious default; reviewers may ask for more detail.

review.noteCreate: Saving creates a draft. Only you and the reviewers can see it; you submit it for review from its page.
review.noteEdit: Saving keeps the card as a draft.

lifecycle.heading: Status of this card

help.DRAFT: Only you and the reviewers can see this card. Submit it for review when it is complete; it can no longer be edited after that.
help.SUBMITTED: A reviewer checks the card before it is published. Returning it to draft lets you edit it again.
help.PUBLISHED: The card is in the public model catalogue.
help.WITHDRAWN: The card is no longer offered. It stays on the record, marked as withdrawn.

lifecycle.forbidden: You are not allowed to make this change.
lifecycle.stale: The card changed in the meantime. Reload the page and try again.
lifecycle.factsDraft: The Model Facts label is generated once the card is submitted for review.

errors.signInRequired: Sign in to declare a model.
errors.slugTaken: A model card with the identifier “{slug}” already exists.
errors.slugTakenField: Already in use; choose another identifier.
errors.notFound: This model card does not exist, or you cannot see it.
errors.notEditable: This card can no longer be edited: only a draft can be, by the person who declared it.
